results.description:
He's a dangerous MC president with a reputation for violence. She's a pre-law student who witnesses murder. When casino corruption threatens them both, their explosive attraction will either save innocent lives or get them both killed.

Jake "Jackpot" Coleman runs Sin City MC with military precision—the kind of leader who solves problems with bullets and never backs down from a fight. When a casino executive starts eliminating witnesses to financial crimes, he never expects to fall hard for the brilliant woman they're hunting.

Madison Brooks saw the wrong murder at the wrong time. Now professional killers want her dead, and her only protection is a lethal biker who fights for justice when the law fails. She's working her way through UNLV law school and won't let anyone—including dangerous men who claim to own her—control her life.

Their attraction is instant. Their enemies are ruthless. Their war is just beginning.

As casino corruption escalates from murder to kidnapping, Jackpot and Madison must fight for their lives and their future together. He'll use every weapon in his brotherhood's arsenal. She'll risk everything to see justice done. Together, they'll either destroy the criminal network forever—or die trying.

Sometimes love is found in the most dangerous places. Sometimes it's worth killing for.

The explosive first book in the Sin City MC series.
